question: What groups arise from the world called the body-bond upward through intellect and ego?
premises: Starting from the world called the body-bond, the qualities of intellect come next.
In that same place there are eight forms of ego in three ways.
Desire and other related factors are also present there.
inference: The cosmological sequence from the body-bond world includes intellect qualities, an eightfold threefold ego, and desire-related factors.
uncertainties: The precise identity of the desire-and-others group is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Beginning from the world called the body-bond, there come the qualities of intellect. There too are the eightfold ego in three forms, and likewise desire and the rest.
